description:
## Scope

Make the two remaining corpus loaders aware of CRLs.

## What

### pem_tree (pkix-difftest/src/corpus/pem_tree.rs)

- Recognize a 'crls/' subdirectory beside the chain dir.
- Each crls/*.crl or crls/*.pem in the dir gets loaded as DER and added to chain.crls.
- Document the convention in module rustdoc.

### limbo (python/limbo-to-pem-tree.py + corpus/pem_tree.rs)

- Limbo testcases have a 'crls' field (list of base64 DER strings).
- limbo-to-pem-tree.py currently filters has-crl testcases out — remove that filter and write the CRLs into the pem-tree output's crls/ subdir as PEM (header CERTIFICATE -> X509 CRL? Or DER directly? — match whatever the pem_tree loader expects).

## Acceptance

- [ ] pem_tree loader picks up CRLs from crls/.
- [ ] limbo-to-pem-tree.py writes CRLs into crls/.
- [ ] limbo has-crl testcases stop being filtered.
- [ ] At least one limbo has-crl testcase loads with chain.crls non-empty.

## Depends on

PKIX-emf1.1.

## Parent

PKIX-emf1.
title: PEM-tree + limbo corpus loaders: thread CRL bytes through Chain
